lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How long have you been studying Chinese?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xué le liǎng nián le.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Yǒudiǎnr nán. Xiě Hànzì zuì nán.
lines.english: A little difficult. Writing characters is the hardest.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我上课，也自己复习。每天听中文。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shàngkè, yě zìjǐ fùxí. Měitiān tīng Zhōngwén.
lines.english: I take classes and also review on my own. I listen to Chinese every day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ huì shuō hěn duō Hànyǔ ma?
lines.english: Can you speak a lot of Chinese?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 会说一些。但是太快我就听不懂。
lines.pinyin: Huì shuō yīxiē. Dànshì tài kuài wǒ jiù tīng bu dǒng.
lines.english: I can speak some. But if it's too fast I can't understand.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 努力吧！你会越来越好的。
lines.pinyin: Nǔlì ba! Nǐ huì yuè lái yuè hǎo de.
lines.english: Keep at it! You'll get better and better.
